_comment: Hologram models (VECTOR's format: vector's tools/holo/collection.py and assets/holo/README.md). Boxes are [x0,x1, y0,y1, z0,z1] in fractions of the normalised bounding box (y up, front +z); a face goes to the first part whose box holds its centroid, else to the part with rest=true. bind names the live reading a part shows (VECTOR's holo/bind.py), empty for a part that only shapes the model. Sources are in src/; the baked NAME.holo.npz sit next to this file. Rebake: ~/.local/share/bromigos/venv/bin/python <vector>/tools/holo/bake.py --root THIS_DIR --preview

parts.label: DOME AND EYE-LAMP
parts.hint: The armoured dome and its one eye-lamp. For no reason anyone can give, the lamp comes up and the Sleeper wades off across the bayou with nobody aboard, on an errand that ended decades ago

parts.label: LEFT ARM
parts.hint: A long arm, the hand hanging past the knee: the war made frames that learned their pilots so well the pilot became optional

parts.label: RIGHT ARM
parts.hint: Moss grows thick on the shoulders and herons nest in the hatches; Hollis tells it the news as it wades past his porch

parts.label: LEGS
parts.hint: Knee drums and heavy shins: it stands in the black water like a tree for years at a time

parts.label: HULL
parts.hint: The hull and waist: no pilot aboard, no war to go back to. The weapons the war left alive, self-aware and unemployed

parts.label: RELAY MAST
parts.hint: The radio mast, taller than the cypresses: the relay is bolted to it and the black flame scorched into its housing just above the flood line. Lit while every channel on the network answers

parts.label: ROWBOAT
parts.hint: The flat-bottomed boat tied at the pilings: Hollis rows the drawings nobody else remembers out to the Petrel

parts.label: PORCH
parts.hint: The porch: a lantern, a rocking chair and the ladder down to the water. Hollis fishes here and tells the Sleepers the news as they wade past

parts.label: TIN ROOF
parts.hint: Corrugated tin over the cabin, patched more times than anyone counted

parts.label: STILTS
parts.hint: Timber pilings over the drowned front: the black water rose over the trenches and gun pits, and the shack stands above the flood line

parts.label: CABIN
parts.hint: The keeper's cabin at the edge of the old front: Relay Corps kit, fishing tackle, and drawings for parts no one else remembers how to make
